sources.title: Belos pseudoblock GMRES solver manager
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: SuperLU：後向誤差、條件數與精化結果
related.titleEn: SuperLU: backward error, conditioning and refinement evidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：容量、真殘差與總成本共同決定，不只看迭代次數。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Capacity, true residual and total cost jointly determine acceptance, not iteration count alone.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「SuperLU：後向誤差、條件數與精化結果」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付原系統殘差、兩種誤差表、條件數討論及精化可重現輸入。
related.differenceEn: Investigate SuperLU: backward error, conditioning and refinement evidence using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver original-system residuals, backward and forward error tables, conditioning analysis and reproducible refinement inputs with exact versus floating-point arithmetic clearly distinguished.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 算單向量八十萬 bytes，再乘二十一；將 MB 與 MiB 區別並禁止省略額外向量。
算殘差 [−0.01,1]，取最大絕對值一；分母為 1000×1.01+1000，再比較解誤差。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute eight hundred thousand bytes per vector and multiply by twenty-one. Distinguish decimal MB from binary MiB and retain the additional Arnoldi vector, which is easily omitted in informal estimates.

Compute residual [-0.01,1] and its infinity norm one. Form denominator 1000*1.01+1000, then separately calculate the solution error relative to [1,1], preserving the distinction between the two diagnostics.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Apache Airflow：半開資料區間與補跑完整性
related.titleEn: Apache Airflow: half-open data intervals and catchup completeness
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：容量、真殘差與總成本共同決定，不只看迭代次數。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Capacity, true residual and total cost jointly determine acceptance, not iteration count alone.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「Apache Airflow：半開資料區間與補跑完整性」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付區間清單、邊界事件歸屬、補跑政策與 logical date 對照。
related.differenceEn: Investigate Apache Airflow: half-open data intervals and catchup completeness using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver interval manifests, boundary-event assignments, catchup policy and logical-date mappings that distinguish represented data time from scheduler and execution timestamps.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 算單向量八十萬 bytes，再乘二十一；將 MB 與 MiB 區別並禁止省略額外向量。
列前兩個完整窗口及 [7200,10800) 尾窗；觀察時間九千只允許前兩窗。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute eight hundred thousand bytes per vector and multiply by twenty-one. Distinguish decimal MB from binary MiB and retain the additional Arnoldi vector, which is easily omitted in informal estimates.

List the first two completed windows and the unfinished [7200,10800) tail. At observation time nine thousand, qualify only completed windows and explain why processing the partial tail would change the dataset contract.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
